data.name: Griff
data.gender_notes: Griff is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'griff,' meaning 'strong, powerful, or fierce.' In medieval Europe, griffins were mythical creatures with the body, tail, and back legs of a lion; the head and wings of an eagle; and an eagle's talons as its front feet. The name Griff carries the meaning “Strong, brave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Griff usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Griff belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Griff total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
